parties.respondent: The State Represented By SHO And Another

summary: Quashing of FIR under Section 482 Cr.P.C. Criminal appeal against order dismissing quashing petition; allegations of cheating and criminal breach of trust under Section 420 read with 34 IPC; fraud inducing property delivery; debt repayment scheme involving multiple transactions structured to mask underlying fraud; validity of pre-investigation quashing; jurisdictional limits of High Court in pruning complaints; post-charge-sheet infructuousness; proof of dishonesty, inducement, and beneficiary transfer required for criminal reference.
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of; High Court's decision affirmed; FIR not quashed; investigation order maintained.
